messages:
anya-support: Customer reported a spike of tool/function call failures after we rolled the model from v2.9 -> v3.0 canary at 2026-02-11 14:10 UTC. They see 400 schema validation errors and some 503s. attaching sample: 

anya-support: request snippet: `{\n  \"model\": \"redwood-v3.0\",\n  \"messages\": [{\"role\":\"user\",\"content\":\"Generate invoice\"}],\n  \"tools\": [{\"name\":\"invoice_creator\",\"args\": {\"amount\": 1250, \"currency\": \"USD\"}}]\n}`

anya-support: response snippet: `400 Bad Request - tool args failed schema validation: \"invoice_creator.amount\": expected integer but got string`

julia-ml: seen this in canary logs too. v3.0 changed float->string coercion behavior for numeric tokenizer tokenization; tool arg marshalling no longer coerces numbers from strings by default.

mike-eng: can we repro locally with the same model binary? which commit rolled?

anya-support: repro steps I used: 1) hit exec API with same payload, 2) set model=redwood-v3.0, 3) repeat 10x -> 6/10 failures with same schema error. first_message_ts=2180023456

sarah-pm: customer is on Dedicated, billing impacted, they flagged SLA breach. need ETA for mitigation.

carter-sre: checking routing: some requests were routed to v3.0-canary group, others to v2.9 fallback. latency also increased for v3.0 ~ 120ms p99 -> 380ms p99 on tokenization step. attaching log excerpt: `tokenize: model=redwood-v3.0 duration_ms=312 sample_id=...`

julia-ml: probable root cause: model-side input normalization changed. Prior runtime accepted numeric strings for schema fields; v3.0 stricter. We didn't surface this as a breaking change in the rollout notes.

mike-eng: quick mitigation options: 1) roll back canary to v2.9 for affected orgs; 2) add a compatibility shim in request marshalling to coerce numeric strings to numbers for tool calls; 3) update schema validation to accept both types for short term.

anya-support: customer asked for immediate rollback. they listed affected endpoints: `/v1/exec` with tool invoice_creator and payment_processor.

carter-sre: prepared rollback patch to route that org back to v2.9. need +1 from eng to execute. will schedule at 14:30 UTC.

julia-ml: +1 for rollback. also will prepare a patch to restore lenient coercion and a proper migration note. this needs a unit test that checks tool arg typing across models.

mike-eng: I'll run the rollback now and watch canary metrics. will also open a PR for the shim: `tools/marshaller: coerce_numeric_strings()` with opt-in flag.

oncall-bot: Deploy started by mike-eng at 14:30:12 UTC — routing change for org-id 05a3 -> target v2.9.

carter-sre: after rollback we see errors drop to 0 for that org and p99 latency back to 145ms. customer confirmed reduced failures.

anya-support: customer updated: "thanks, failures stopped after you reverted canary. please advise long-term fix."

julia-ml: long-term plan: 1) add non-breaking marshalling shim, 2) add model onboarding checklist item to document input normalization changes, 3) add canary validation test that exercises tool calling with mixed-type args.

mike-eng: filing follow-up ticket with priority P1 to ensure we ship the shim and tests before re-roll. ticket: INF-4821.

anya-support: thanks — will keep customer in the loop and schedule a postmortem with the rollout owner. :thumbsup:
